title: Call out what a release breaks
statement: As a developer, I can mark a note as breaking and say what someone must do about it, so people upgrading learn what will break before it breaks for them.
overview: Proposed addition. v0.7.0 removed the old work plan and made a `___workplan` directory invalid; the changelog said what to do, but nothing tied that to a story or asked anyone to check a real Saga. Proving a release does not break a known Saga is a checklist step, not a feature: run the new binary's `validate` against it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Marking a note breaking without saying what the reader must do is refused.
A release's breaking notes appear first in the reader and in `release notes` output, and say what to do.
The tool makes no claim that an unmarked release is safe: a release with no breaking note reads as having none recorded.
